records.name: Sergeant Festgefroren
records.biography_en: Keeps moving chiefly to avoid becoming another landmark. He folds a HyperNorm map along boundaries that keep moving overnight. A dissonant card remembers where the stairwell used to be. The Men in Black demand a single direction; Hunky and Dory change the destination. He leaves a little room for those who cannot keep up.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Standpunkt bleibt beweglich bis zum Gegenbefehl.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps moving chiefly to avoid becoming another landmark.

records.name: Späherin Weitsicht
records.biography_en: Notices the small detail missing from every grand plan. Her scope notices the frightened HyperNorm neighbour hidden behind a triumphant briefing. She lowers the rifle whenever certainty looks too easy. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Detail widerspricht leider dem Gesamtbild.

variant_notes.note_en: Notices the small detail missing from every grand plan.

records.name: Funkerina Rauschen
records.biography_en: Translates static into something headquarters will accept. She reads HyperNorm message strips that make perfect sense until placed together. A dissonant card asks her to keep the scraps. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Meldung ist vollständig. Der Zusammenhang fehlt.

variant_notes.note_en: Translates static into something headquarters will accept.

records.name: Tankist Rückwärtsgang
records.biography_en: Can hear an engine requesting permission to give up. His padded cap muffles the HyperNorm engine and very little of the management. A dissonant card recommends listening the other way round. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Motor schweigt aus eigener Sachkenntnis.

variant_notes.note_en: Can hear an engine requesting permission to give up.

records.name: Infanterist Nurweiter
records.biography_en: Finds courage whenever somebody smaller is watching. He carries courage through HyperNorm in a satchel officially assigned to spare certainty. A dissonant card makes room for doubt. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Weitergehen gilt zunächst nur für die Füße, die er nicht hat.

variant_notes.note_en: Finds courage whenever somebody smaller is watching.

records.name: Versorger Letzterrest
records.biography_en: Distributes the last portion with the optimism of a man expecting another. His kettle warms HyperNorm portions that exist on paper before arriving in cupboards. A dissonant card saves a cup for a late neighbour. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der letzte Rest wurde fürsorglich mehrfach verplant.

variant_notes.note_en: Distributes the last portion with the optimism of a man expecting another.
